description: Fork of exp104 with per-table 'field of view' on out_proj only — both lookup AND scatter share the same width-65 window per table (aligned_local_scatter=True). out_proj input=H*d_v=384=E so windows align in index space. qk_joint and v_lut keep exp104's full uniform behavior (no locality). max_anchor_distance=64 for out_proj. Tests whether local input AND output windows on out_proj alone help vs exp104 baseline.
